final_decision.reason: Two and four compatible observations produced monotonic held-out geometry gains beyond frame repetition and simple averaging. Local tile behavior and motion remained safe. Candidate-head disagreement was not a valid uncertainty measure, but pre-fusion structural admission plus observation-jackknife uncertainty detected mismatched bundles and safely fell back to one observation. Real-image alignment, nuisance estimation, sequence output and external GMF remain unvalidated.

question: Does one variable-observation evidence-set model become more geometrically reliable when given four aligned observations of the same latent scene, and does multiple-hypothesis physics selection add value beyond a matched single-answer arm?

evaluation.full_model_authorization: The four-observation evidence output must reduce held-out contour and transition-center errors relative to both its one-observation mode and the matched point arm, while uncertainty, motion, exposure and tile behavior remain coherent.
